description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for the openwrt project, including checks, upgrades, and configuration copying tailored to specific hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the platform by performing board-specific validation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on the device, selecting the appropriate upgrade method based on the board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to the device depending on the board.
